question:
Simplify the following:

lbrace{((frac{7)/(2)div (5)/(2) times (3)/(2))}{((7)/(2)div ( (5)/(2) times (3)/(2)))}rbrace}div 5.25
solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba9bb55bc53309131d6e6cbfc42163dc1ca515199dce2ab78948e0af61b5830a.png] 

**Calculation:**

lbrace{((frac{7)/(2)÷ (5)/(2) × (3)/(2))}{((7)/(2)÷ ( (5)/(2) × (3)/(2)))}rbrace}÷ 5.25

⇒ {(7/2 × 2/5 × 3/2)/(7/2 × 4/15)} ÷ 5.25

⇒ {(21/10)/(14/15)} ÷ 5.25

⇒ {21/10 × 15/14} ÷ 5.25

⇒ {9/4} ÷ 5.25

⇒ 9/4 × 1/5.25

⇒ 9/4 × 100/525

⇒ 3/7

**∴ The required result = 3/7**
